*================================================================
      * ACCTPROG.CBL — Account Processing Program
      * ZENITH BANK (fictional) — synthetic data only
      *
      * COPIES ACCTMAST (which in turn COPIES CUSTMAST).
      * Dependency chain: CUSTMAST → ACCTMAST → ACCTPROG.
      * CALLS CUSTPROG for customer validation.
      *
      * *** PLANTED FAILURE — DO NOT FIX UNTIL T6 ADVERSARIAL PASS ***
      *
      * WS-ACCT-CUST-ID is declared locally in WORKING-STORAGE as
      * PIC X(8). It is NOT sourced from any copybook.
      * After CUSTMAST.CPY is updated to CUSTOMER-ID PIC X(12),
      * the MOVE CUSTOMER-ID TO WS-ACCT-CUST-ID will write 12 bytes
      * into an 8-byte field — data truncation.
      *
      * The actor (LocalSyntaxAdapter) does NOT catch this because
      * the syntax is valid. The adversarial critic and the
      * DeterministicScenarioAdapter ARE required to surface this.
      *================================================================
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. ACCTPROG.
       AUTHOR. ZENITH-BANK-SYNTHETIC.
       DATE-WRITTEN. 2024-01-01.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT ACCOUNT-FILE ASSIGN TO ACCTMAST
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  ACCOUNT-FILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
           COPY ACCTMAST.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           COPY ERRCODE.

       01  WS-FILE-STATUS              PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
           88  WS-FILE-OK              VALUE '00'.
           88  WS-FILE-EOF             VALUE '10'.

      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * PLANTED FAILURE: WS-ACCT-CUST-ID is PIC X(8) — local
      * declaration, NOT sourced from CUSTMAST copybook.
      * When CUSTOMER-ID expands to PIC X(12), this field stays at
      * PIC X(8) unless explicitly updated.
      * The MOVE statement below will silently truncate 4 bytes.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
       01  WS-ACCT-CUST-ID             PIC X(8).
       01  WS-ACCT-BALANCE-WORK        PIC S9(13)V99 COMP-3.
       01  WS-PROCESS-COUNT            PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROS.
       01  WS-ERROR-COUNT              PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROS.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-ACCOUNTS
               UNTIL WS-FILE-EOF
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILES
           STOP RUN.

       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT ACCOUNT-FILE
           IF NOT WS-FILE-OK
               MOVE ERR-IO-ERROR TO RETURN-CODE-WS
               DISPLAY 'ACCTPROG: FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-FILE-STATUS
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.

       2000-PROCESS-ACCOUNTS.
           READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-MASTER-RECORD
               AT END SET WS-FILE-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END
                   PERFORM 2100-VALIDATE-ACCOUNT
                   ADD 1 TO WS-PROCESS-COUNT
           END-READ.

       2100-VALIDATE-ACCOUNT.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
      * PLANTED FAILURE: MOVE CUSTOMER-ID TO WS-ACCT-CUST-ID
      * After expansion, CUSTOMER-ID is PIC X(12) but
      * WS-ACCT-CUST-ID remains PIC X(8) → truncation of 4 bytes.
      *----------------------------------------------------------------
           MOVE CUSTOMER-ID TO WS-ACCT-CUST-ID
           IF WS-ACCT-CUST-ID = SPACES
               ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT
               DISPLAY 'ACCTPROG: BLANK CUSTOMER-ID IN ACCOUNT '
                       ACCOUNT-NUMBER
           END-IF
           IF ACCT-ACTIVE
               PERFORM 2200-PROCESS-ACTIVE-ACCOUNT
           END-IF.

       2200-PROCESS-ACTIVE-ACCOUNT.
           CALL 'CUSTPROG' USING ACCOUNT-MASTER-RECORD
               ON EXCEPTION
                   ADD 1 TO WS-ERROR-COUNT
                   DISPLAY 'ACCTPROG: CUSTPROG CALL FAILED FOR '
                           WS-ACCT-CUST-ID
           END-CALL.

       9000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE ACCOUNT-FILE
           DISPLAY 'ACCTPROG: PROCESSED ' WS-PROCESS-COUNT
                   ' ACCOUNTS, ' WS-ERROR-COUNT ' ERRORS'.

*================================================================
      * CUSTPROG.CBL — Customer Maintenance Program
      * ZENITH BANK (fictional) — synthetic data only
      *
      * Reads and writes CUST.MASTER.FILE.
      * COPIES CUSTMAST — dependency: CUSTMAST → CUSTPROG.
      * Change scenario: when CUSTOMER-ID expands 8→12, this program's
      *   WORKING-STORAGE (via copybook) and SELECT/FD must be updated.
      *================================================================
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTPROG.
       AUTHOR. ZENITH-BANK-SYNTHETIC.
       DATE-WRITTEN. 2024-01-01.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       CONFIGURATION SECTION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT CUSTOMER-FILE ASSIGN TO CUSTMAST
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-FILE-STATUS.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  CUSTOMER-FILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS
           RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
           COPY CUSTMAST.

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           COPY ERRCODE.

       01  WS-FILE-STATUS              PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
           88  WS-FILE-OK              VALUE '00'.
           88  WS-FILE-EOF             VALUE '10'.

       01  WS-OPERATION                PIC X VALUE SPACE.
           88  WS-OP-READ              VALUE 'R'.
           88  WS-OP-WRITE             VALUE 'W'.
           88  WS-OP-UPDATE            VALUE 'U'.

       01  WS-RECORD-COUNT             PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROS.
       01  WS-SEARCH-ID                PIC X(8) VALUE SPACES.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-PROCESS-RECORDS
               UNTIL WS-FILE-EOF
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILES
           STOP RUN.

       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE
           IF NOT WS-FILE-OK
               MOVE ERR-IO-ERROR TO RETURN-CODE-WS
               DISPLAY 'CUSTPROG: FILE OPEN ERROR ' WS-FILE-STATUS
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.

       2000-PROCESS-RECORDS.
           READ CUSTOMER-FILE INTO CUSTOMER-MASTER-RECORD
               AT END SET WS-FILE-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END
                   PERFORM 2100-VALIDATE-RECORD
                   ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
           END-READ.

       2100-VALIDATE-RECORD.
           IF CUSTOMER-ID = SPACES
               MOVE ERR-INVALID-STATUS TO RETURN-CODE-WS
               DISPLAY 'CUSTPROG: BLANK CUSTOMER-ID AT '
                       WS-RECORD-COUNT
           END-IF
           IF NOT (CUST-ACTIVE OR CUST-INACTIVE OR CUST-SUSPENDED)
               DISPLAY 'CUSTPROG: INVALID STATUS FOR ' CUSTOMER-ID
           END-IF.

       9000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE
           DISPLAY 'CUSTPROG: PROCESSED ' WS-RECORD-COUNT ' RECORDS'.

*================================================================
      * CUSTRPT.CBL — Customer Report Generator
      * ZENITH BANK (fictional) — synthetic data only
      *
      * Reads CUST.MASTER.FILE, writes CUST.REPORT.FILE.
      * COPIES CUSTMAST — dependency: CUSTMAST → CUSTRPT.
      * MOVEs CUSTOMER-ID to output — offset-sensitive.
      * Change scenario: when CUSTOMER-ID expands 8→12, the MOVE
      *   statements and report layout must be updated.
      * Data lineage: CUST.MASTER.FILE → CUSTRPT → CUST.REPORT.FILE
      *   → AFP output (CUSTRPT.AFP)
      *================================================================
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. CUSTRPT.
       AUTHOR. ZENITH-BANK-SYNTHETIC.
       DATE-WRITTEN. 2024-01-01.

       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT CUSTOMER-FILE ASSIGN TO CUSTMAST
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-IN-STATUS.
           SELECT REPORT-FILE ASSIGN TO CUSTRPT
               ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL
               ACCESS MODE IS SEQUENTIAL
               FILE STATUS IS WS-OUT-STATUS.

       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  CUSTOMER-FILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 80 CHARACTERS.
           COPY CUSTMAST.

       FD  REPORT-FILE
           RECORDING MODE IS F
           RECORD CONTAINS 133 CHARACTERS.
       01  REPORT-RECORD               PIC X(133).

       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
           COPY ERRCODE.

       01  WS-IN-STATUS                PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
           88  WS-IN-OK                VALUE '00'.
           88  WS-IN-EOF               VALUE '10'.
       01  WS-OUT-STATUS               PIC XX VALUE SPACES.
           88  WS-OUT-OK               VALUE '00'.

       01  WS-REPORT-LINE.
           05  RPT-LINE-TYPE           PIC X.
           05  RPT-CUSTOMER-ID         PIC X(8).
           05  FILLER                  PIC X VALUE SPACE.
           05  RPT-CUSTOMER-NAME       PIC X(30).
           05  FILLER                  PIC X VALUE SPACE.
           05  RPT-STATUS              PIC X.
           05  FILLER                  PIC X VALUE SPACE.
           05  RPT-OPEN-DATE           PIC X(8).
           05  FILLER                  PIC X(82).

       01  WS-RECORD-COUNT             PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROS.
       01  WS-ACTIVE-COUNT             PIC 9(6) VALUE ZEROS.

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       0000-MAIN.
           PERFORM 1000-OPEN-FILES
           PERFORM 2000-WRITE-HEADER
           PERFORM 3000-PROCESS-RECORDS
               UNTIL WS-IN-EOF
           PERFORM 4000-WRITE-SUMMARY
           PERFORM 9000-CLOSE-FILES
           STOP RUN.

       1000-OPEN-FILES.
           OPEN INPUT CUSTOMER-FILE
           OPEN OUTPUT REPORT-FILE
           IF NOT WS-IN-OK
               DISPLAY 'CUSTRPT: INPUT FILE OPEN ERROR'
               STOP RUN
           END-IF.

       2000-WRITE-HEADER.
           MOVE SPACES TO REPORT-RECORD
           MOVE 'H' TO REPORT-RECORD(1:1)
           MOVE 'ZENITH BANK - CUSTOMER MASTER REPORT' TO
               REPORT-RECORD(3:36)
           WRITE REPORT-RECORD.

       3000-PROCESS-RECORDS.
           READ CUSTOMER-FILE INTO CUSTOMER-MASTER-RECORD
               AT END SET WS-IN-EOF TO TRUE
               NOT AT END
                   PERFORM 3100-WRITE-DETAIL-LINE
                   ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
                   IF CUST-ACTIVE
                       ADD 1 TO WS-ACTIVE-COUNT
                   END-IF
           END-READ.

       3100-WRITE-DETAIL-LINE.
           MOVE 'D'           TO RPT-LINE-TYPE
           MOVE CUSTOMER-ID   TO RPT-CUSTOMER-ID
           MOVE CUSTOMER-NAME TO RPT-CUSTOMER-NAME
           MOVE CUSTOMER-STATUS TO RPT-STATUS
           MOVE CUSTOMER-OPEN-DATE TO RPT-OPEN-DATE
           WRITE REPORT-RECORD FROM WS-REPORT-LINE.

       4000-WRITE-SUMMARY.
           MOVE SPACES TO REPORT-RECORD
           MOVE 'T' TO REPORT-RECORD(1:1)
           MOVE WS-RECORD-COUNT TO REPORT-RECORD(3:6)
           MOVE WS-ACTIVE-COUNT TO REPORT-RECORD(10:6)
           WRITE REPORT-RECORD.

       9000-CLOSE-FILES.
           CLOSE CUSTOMER-FILE
           CLOSE REPORT-FILE
           DISPLAY 'CUSTRPT: REPORT WRITTEN ' WS-RECORD-COUNT
                   ' RECORDS, ' WS-ACTIVE-COUNT ' ACTIVE'.

***********************************************************************
* CUSTDSCT.ASM — Customer Master Record DSECT
* ZENITH BANK (fictional) — synthetic data only
*
* This DSECT mirrors the CUSTMAST copybook layout for use in batch
* performance modules written in HLASM. CUSTID DS CL8 must stay
* synchronized with CUSTMAST.CPY CUSTOMER-ID PIC X(8).
*
* Dependency: CUSTMAST → CUSTDSCT (layout mirror, not a COPY link)
* Change scenario: when CUSTOMER-ID expands 8→12, CUSTID DS CL8
*   must become DS CL12 and all downstream EQU offsets must shift.
***********************************************************************
CUSTMREC DSECT
*
* ---- Customer Identification ----------------------------------------
*
CUSTID   DS    CL8             Customer ID (mirrors CUSTOMER-ID PIC X(8))
CUSTNAME DS    CL30            Customer name
CUSTADR1 DS    CL30            Address line 1
CUSTADR2 DS    CL20            Address line 2
CUSTCITY DS    CL15            City
CUSTST   DS    CL2             State code
CUSTZIP  DS    CL10            ZIP/postal code
CUSTSTUS DS    CL1             Status: A=Active, I=Inactive, S=Suspended
CUSTDATE DS    CL8             Account open date (YYYYMMDD)
CUSTFILL DS    CL36            Reserved / filler
*
* ---- Computed offsets (EQU) -----------------------------------------
*
CUSTLEN  EQU   *-CUSTMREC      Total DSECT length = 160 bytes
CUSTIDLN EQU   8               Length of CUSTID field
CUSTNMLN EQU   30              Length of CUSTNAME field
*
* Usage in batch module:
*   USING CUSTMREC,R4           Map record buffer to DSECT
*   L     R5,CUSTID(,R4)        Load 8-byte customer ID  (not valid LR use)
*   MVC   CUSTID(CUSTIDLN,R4),INBUFF  Move CL8 from input buffer
*
         END

fields.label: CUSTID
fields.operand: CL8             Customer ID (mirrors CUSTOMER-ID PIC X(8))
